description: Seismic lines in the Upper Rhine Graben is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by europe-geology.eu. Public seismic profiles of the DGE-ROLLOUT project in the Upper Rhine Graben. The raw data are accessible on request to national Geological Surveys of France (BRGM), Netherlands (TNO), Germany (GD-NRW), Belgium (GSB) or to Technical University of Darmstadt for the Upper Rhine Graben. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include deep geothermal energy, seismic lines. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
